summary: Batch B (Sprints 11–14) authoritative regression PASSED. Created /app/backend/tests/test_batch_b_regression.py — 32/32 tests green. critical_code_review_comments: api/customers.py: consent_at stamping is one-shot (only when transitioning from falsy consent_at to privacy_consent=True). Correct per business rule.
api/catalog.py _validate_gemstones: iterates gemstone_ids sequentially; OK for small lists but O(N) DB round trips — consider a single $in query if lists get large.

api/media.py _demote_existing_main + _link_media + _unlink_media: single-main invariant is enforced both on upload-with-role=main AND on POST /main endpoint. Delete unlink path exercised and confirmed.
api/certificates.py delete_gemstone correctly blocks (409) when certificate_id is set; soft-delete otherwise. list_gemstones now returns {items,total,page,page_size} envelope-consistent shape.
Response never includes Mongo _id in any tested projection (Customer, Gemstone, Jewelry, Media views all whitelist fields).

Frontend TESTID coverage matches the spec (page-admin-{customers|gemstones|jewelry}, customer-add-btn/save/delete-{uuid}, jewelry-add-btn/save/gem-{uuid}, media-*). Add-customer, delete-customer confirm() dialog works.
Minor DX: previous test iteration left one soft-deleted customer after FE UI delete (soft-delete via API). Not a bug — expected behavior; explicitly hard-purged during cleanup.
